regional.title: Regional
regional.description: Default language, time zone and date/time formats for every user. Users can choose their own values under Preferences. Data is still stored in UTC.

hint.timezone: IANA zone name, e.g. Asia/Jakarta (WIB), Asia/Makassar (WITA), Asia/Jayapura (WIT).

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Choose the language, time zone and date/time formats for your account. "Follow system" uses the Admin's settings.

allowlist.description: Restrict who may open the web panel by IP address or network. The IP is taken from the direct connection to the server; headers sent by the browser are not trusted. The SSH allowlist follows in v0.12.
allowlist.myIpLabel: Added from the Allowed IP page

modeHelp.off: Every IP may open the panel. Nothing is recorded.
modeHelp.monitor: Every IP may, but access from IPs outside the list is recorded in the Audit Log. Use this first to check the list.
modeHelp.enforce: Only IPs in the list may open the panel; others get "Access denied".

allowlist.guard: Your current IP is not in the list. Add it first so you do not lock yourself out.
allowlist.enforceBody: Only IPs in the list will be able to open the panel. Afterwards, press "Keep" within {{seconds}} seconds from a connection that is still working; otherwise the mode returns to Monitor automatically.
allowlist.pending: Enforce is waiting for confirmation: it returns to Monitor automatically in {{time}} unless you press Keep.
allowlist.cidrHint: IPv4 or IPv6. A single address is stored as /32 or /128. At most /8 (IPv4) or /16 (IPv6) wide.
allowlist.label: Label
allowlist.empty: No IPs yet. Add at least your own IP before using Enforce.
allowlist.editBody: A label helps to recognise who owns this network.
allowlist.removeBody: This network will no longer be in the list.
allowlist.removeBodyEnforce: Enforce is active: users from this network lose access immediately. Removing the network that covers your own IP is refused.
allowlist.alwaysPublicHelp: For health monitoring and automatic HTTPS certificate renewal.
